text:
maria: hey team 👋 I'm starting today — quick access question. I need GCP access for the APAC project so I can run queries in BigQuery and connect to Cloud SQL for the demo. also need the billing account linked and permission to create service accounts. which project/billing id should I reference?
priya-sre: welcome! can you paste the GCP project id you were assigned? we typically give `roles/bigquery.dataViewer` + `roles/cloudsql.client` to new devs, and `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` for service account access.
sam-peopleops: hi maria — congrats! people ops needs your manager's approval recorded first. please fill the onboarding cloud access form: https://redwood.internal/onboard-cloud (select APAC) and CC your manager. once that's in, we kick off infra access.
omar-billing: for billing: use `redwood-apac-billing` unless you're on a dedicated customer project — if so tell me the customer billing id. to link project to billing I need the project id and the owner's email. I can grant `roles/billing.user` to the infra bot for linking.
maria: thanks — project id is `redwood-apac-dev-13` and manager is @jordan. customer? no, internal demo project.
priya-sre: got it. @sam-peopleops can you confirm you see the form + manager approval? I'll prepare the IAM changes. also, for AWS access: maria, do you need cross-account S3 read role?
maria: yes for one dataset we mirror from S3 in ap-southeast-1. need read-only.
omar-billing: noted. I'll link `redwood-apac-dev-13` to `redwood-apac-billing` after approvals.
devex: quick tip — infra can add IAM bindings with this command once they have the project: ```bash
# grant BigQuery viewer and Cloud SQL client
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-apac-dev-13 \
  --member="user:maria@redwood.com" \
  --role="roles/bigquery.dataViewer" 

gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-apac-dev-13 \
  --member="user:maria@redwood.com" \
  --role="roles/cloudsql.client"
```
priya-sre: thanks. maria — for the AWS role we create an ARN like `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodOncallReadOnly`. please DM me the exact permissions you need or open an eng-infra ticket with `APAC S3 read` in the title.
maria: pinged @jordan for approval and filled the form. opened the eng-infra ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/ND-4521 (brief: APAC S3 read + link GCP project to billing).
deploy-bot: ticket ND-4521 created by maria and assigned to priya-sre. ETA: 24h.
priya-sre: I've scheduled the IAM changes once people-ops confirms. omar — you'll get a request from me for billing link.
sam-peopleops: saw the form + manager approval. moving forward with access request. should be done today. :tada:
